{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Merino wool blend coat, cropped length at the hip, charcoal gray (#3d4254), soft woven fabric.
Relaxed fit knit blouse, standard length hitting mid-thigh, warm beige (#e8dcc9), fine gauge knit fabric.
High-rise straight-leg trousers, full length reaching the ankle bone, deep forest green (#1b3a2f), heavy cotton twill fabric.
Chunky leather Chelsea boots, ankle height, polished black (#0a0a0a), smooth genuine leather.
This outfit works because the wool coat provides necessary warmth against the frosty +2 °C temperature while keeping the silhouette sleek for a city walk. The earth-toned knit top and deep green trousers create a harmonious, grounded palette that flatters her skin tone without feeling too heavy for daylight hours. Combining relaxed knits with sturdy leather footwear offers a balance of comfort for reading or strolling and enough structure to respect the everyday dress code."}
